sources.entry: Simple NixOS Mailserver - Complete mailserver solution leveraging the Nix Ecosystem. GPL-3.0 Nix

summary.name: simple-nixos-mailserver
summary.one_liner: A declarative, complete mail server setup for NixOS built on Postfix, Dovecot, Rspamd and ClamAV.
use_cases: Running a self-hosted email server on NixOS
Configuring a mail server declaratively in Nix
Setting up DKIM, DANE and MTA-STS for a domain
Filtering spam and scanning mail for viruses
Managing multiple email domains and catch-all aliases
summary.what_it_does: The project provides a declarative NixOS module that sets up a complete mail server. It configures Postfix for SMTP (ports 25, 465 and 587) and Dovecot for IMAP and POP3 with TLS or StartTLS, with LMTP delivery between them. Spam filtering and DKIM signing are handled by Rspamd, and virus scanning by ClamAV. It supports ACME or custom certificates, DANE and MTA-STS validation, declarative user and password management, LDAP users, Sieve scripts, and regular and catch-all aliases. Separate branches are published for each NixOS release and for unstable.
notable: Built on Postfix, Dovecot, Rspamd and ClamAV with declarative configuration
Per-NixOS-release branches; only the matching branch is supported
Supports DANE, MTA-STS and SMTP TLS Reports (RFC 8460)
caveats: Only the branch matching the NixOS release is supported
Automatic client configuration and OpenID Connect are planned but not yet available
Improved forwarding experience is listed as a future item
